entry.title: The Protein Routine That Keeps Me Fit, Lean & Energised

media:group.media:title: The Protein Routine That Keeps Me Fit, Lean & Energised
media:group.media:description:
Eating enough protein as a busy woman, can feel impossible. Between work, study, toddlers, sleep regressions, travel, and the general circus of life… your own meals are usually the first thing sacrificed.
In this vlog, I’m breaking down exactly how I hit 100g+ of protein a day while working full-time, studying psychology, training, travelling for events, and raising my daughter. No perfection. No overthinking. Just a simple, evidence-based system that actually works in real life.
You’ll learn:
• Why we need more protein than most of us realise • What the latest research really says about muscle, metabolism, and ageing • How to calculate YOUR protein needs (based on a recent meta-analysis data) • What protein actually looks like across a whole day • Easy meals, snacks, and systems to make hitting your target simple • The truth about weight gain while breastfeeding and early motherhood — and why it’s nothing to be ashamed of • How I structure my routine to feel strong, energised, and capable again
If you want support with your training — whether you’re lifting in the gym, training at home, postpartum, rebuilding strength, or juggling the beautiful chaos of life — you’ll find my programmes and coaching options below.
✨ TRAIN WITH ME Online programmes, mobility, strength, flexibility, and postpartum options: 👉 www.shonavertue.com
✨ 1:1 COACHING (Limited spaces) Apply here for personalised programming & psychological support: 👉 email - help@vertuecrew.com
✨ FOLLOW ALONG Instagram: @shona_vertue TikTok: @shonavertue
Strong body. Clear mind. Enough protein. Let’s go.

entry.title: How I Stay Productive Without Burning Out (Mum, Student, Business Owner)

media:group.media:title: How I Stay Productive Without Burning Out (Mum, Student, Business Owner)
media:group.media:description:
Hi YouTube family — I’m back on this channel (and still on my new @dailyten-today channel too). I really hope these productivity tips help you.
Productivity can feel like such a triggering topic, especially for mums, students and business owners. I couldn’t find anything out there that really spoke to us — so this is the start of more videos I want to share on my own journey. My hope is that we can build a supportive community that makes productivity feel less overwhelming and more realistic.
Let me know in the comments if you already do any of these, if one of them helps you, or if there’s something you’ve learned that I missed.

entry.title: What grief does to us and what it gives back | Vertue Podcast

media:group.media:title: What grief does to us and what it gives back | Vertue Podcast
media:group.media:description:
In this deeply personal episode, I explore grief from all angles—the physical, the psychological, and the spiritual.
Whether you’re grieving the loss of a loved one, a life chapter, or a version of yourself, this episode is for you. Although I mostly talk about death - so if you're here because of a break up, my episode on break ups is better suited for you and you can find it here:
https://podcasts.apple.com/au/podcast/17-break-up-survival-using-the-biopsychosocial-approach/id1701594403?i=1000642705808
In this episode
I’ll walk you through: • What grief actually is (and what it isn’t) • How grief impacts your brain, nervous system, and body • The difference between slow goodbyes and sudden loss • How movement, breath, and ritual can support healing • And finally, how grief—when allowed—can deepen the way we live and love
I also share journal prompts and stories that helped me navigate the loss of my own mother.
This is not a how-to. It’s a soft space to feel what’s true.
Lots of love, Shona.
